title: caltha palustris var. asarifolia
intro: Caltha palustris var. asarifolia, commonly known as marsh marigold, is a perennial plant species that grows in wetland areas. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Caltha palustris var. asarifolia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
